annotations.title: Insulation calculator (IECC R-value targets, bags, savings)

description: Insulation calculator (IECC R-value targets, bags, savings) — Insulation target and materials estimator. Required: zone (IECC/DOE climate zone 1-8, 4C = marine) and area_sqft. Optional: location (attic | wall | floor, default attic), material (blown-cellulose | blown-fiberglass | batts | spray-open | spray-closed | rigid-xps | rigid-polyiso), current_r (existing R-value, default 0), target_r (default = IECC 2021 prescriptive value), stud (2x4 | 2x6 for walls), hdd (heating degree days, default typical for the zone), heating_efficiency (default 0.9), fuel_price ($ per therm). Returns the zone's full code requirements (attic, wall, floor, basement, slab, crawlspace), R to add, depth, blown bags or batt choice or board feet, and estimated yearly heating savings in therms, heat-pump kWh and dollars. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: eng_insulation
